preguntas.pregunta: A refund agent gives correct final answers in testing, but in production it sometimes issues refunds without first calling verify_order. Which evaluation dimension would have caught this?

opciones.A: Tool trajectory evaluation (expected tool calls and their order/arguments).

preguntas.explicacion: Calidad de agentes = trayectoria (qué herramientas, con qué argumentos, en qué orden) + respuesta final. Saltarse verify_order es un error de trayectoria que no se ve mirando solo la respuesta.

preguntas.pregunta: Your research agent legitimately performs between 3 and 7 searches before calling summarize, but it must always call search before summarize. The EXACT trajectory metric fails most runs. What should you configure?

opciones.B: Use BLEU on the final response.
opciones.C: Use an IN_ORDER (or ANY_ORDER where order doesn't matter) trajectory match that checks the required calls without penalizing extra ones.
opciones.D: Keep EXACT and lower the threshold to 0.1.

preguntas.explicacion: EXACT exige llamadas idénticas sin extras. IN_ORDER verifica las requeridas en orden permitiendo extras; ANY_ORDER si el orden no importa.

preguntas.pregunta: Reference answers exist, but the agent phrases correct answers differently each time, so response_match_score (ROUGE-based) is low even for correct outputs. What should you use?

opciones.C: An LLM-judged semantic equivalence metric such as final_response_match_v2.

preguntas.explicacion: ROUGE/BLEU miden solapamiento léxico. Con paráfrasis válidas se usa un juez semántico contra la referencia (final_response_match_v2).

preguntas.pregunta: For open-ended travel recommendations there is no single correct answer, but the business can describe what 'good' means (mentions budget, cites sources, no unsafe advice). Which evaluation approach fits?

opciones.A: Count the words in the answer.
opciones.B: Rubric-based LLM-as-judge criteria (e.g. rubric_based_final_response_quality) with explicit rubrics, calibrated against human ratings.

preguntas.explicacion: Sin referencia → juez con rúbricas explícitas. Calibra el juez con calificaciones humanas antes de usarlo como gate.

preguntas.pregunta: You want to gate every pull request of an ADK agent on quality without making CI slow, costly or flaky. What is the best design?

opciones.B: On every PR run a small golden evalset with deterministic metrics (tool trajectory, response match) via pytest/adk eval; run the larger LLM-judge and user-simulation suites nightly or before release.
opciones.C: Run the full LLM-judge suite with 500 cases on every commit.
opciones.D: Only evaluate manually before each release.

preguntas.explicacion: Métricas deterministas baratas como gate por PR; suites con juez LLM (lentas, costosas, con varianza) en nightly/pre-release. Evaluación continua, no solo en un notebook.

preguntas.pregunta: You are building the first evaluation dataset for a customer-service agent that has been in pilot for a month. Which source should form the core of the golden set?

opciones.A: Real sessions and production traces from the pilot (curated and labeled), complemented with synthetic edge cases and adversarial prompts.
opciones.C: Only synthetic prompts generated by an LLM.

preguntas.explicacion: Prioriza tráfico real (sesiones/trazas curadas) y compleméntalo con casos borde, adversariales y sintéticos para cubrir huecos.

preguntas.pregunta: Six weeks after launch, users report answers are getting worse, although offline evals still pass. What should you implement?

opciones.A: Online evaluation monitors that sample production traces, score them (e.g. hallucination, task success, safety), alert on trends, and feed low-scoring traces back into the golden set.
opciones.B: Re-run the same offline evalset daily.

preguntas.explicacion: Drift de producción → monitores online sobre trazas reales con alertas; cierra el ciclo añadiendo los casos fallidos al golden set.

preguntas.pregunta: The agent confidently states policy details that are not in any retrieved document. Which metric specifically detects this?

opciones.B: A hallucination/groundedness metric that checks each claim against the context and tool outputs (e.g. hallucinations_v1).

preguntas.explicacion: Afirmaciones no respaldadas → métrica de alucinación/groundedness que valida cada frase contra el contexto y las salidas de herramientas.

preguntas.pregunta: A Python ADK agent needs managed sessions and memory, built-in tracing and minimal operations; the team has no Kubernetes skills. Which runtime fits best?

opciones.A: Agent Runtime (formerly Vertex AI Agent Engine).

preguntas.explicacion: Agente Python/ADK, sesiones y memoria gestionadas, mínima operación → Agent Runtime.

preguntas.pregunta: An agent written in TypeScript must be exposed as an HTTP service, scale to zero at night, and sit behind the company's existing load balancer and IAP. Which runtime fits best?
preguntas.explicacion: Cualquier lenguaje en contenedor, serverless, scale-to-zero e integración HTTP/LB/IAP → Cloud Run.

preguntas.pregunta: An ADK agent on Cloud Run loses conversation context whenever it scales in or a new revision is deployed. Session affinity is already enabled. What is the correct fix?

opciones.A: Externalize sessions (e.g. --session_service_uri pointing to Agent Platform Sessions or a Cloud SQL database) instead of in-memory sessions.

preguntas.explicacion: La afinidad de sesión es best-effort y no sobrevive a terminaciones. El estado debe externalizarse (agentengine:// o base de datos).

preguntas.pregunta: Cloud Trace shows some invocations with dozens of repeated call_llm → execute_tool spans lasting minutes, and token usage spikes. What is the most direct ADK safeguard?

opciones.C: Set max_llm_calls in the RunConfig to a sensible positive limit (and tighten tool descriptions/termination conditions).

preguntas.explicacion: max_llm_calls acota las llamadas al LLM por invocación. Ojo: 0 o negativo = sin límite. Además mejora descripciones y condiciones de salida.

preguntas.pregunta: A flaky backend API causes occasional tool errors that abort the whole agent run. You want the agent to reflect on the error and retry a bounded number of times across all tools. What should you add?

opciones.A: A LoopAgent around the whole agent with no limit.
opciones.D: ReflectAndRetryToolPlugin with a small max_retries on the Runner/App.

preguntas.explicacion: El plugin de reflexión y reintento captura errores de herramientas, pide al modelo corregir y reintenta de forma acotada, aplicado globalmente.

preguntas.pregunta: Response latency grows steadily as conversations get longer; traces show input tokens increasing every turn. Which TWO changes help most? (Choose 2)

opciones.B: Limit the history loaded per turn (e.g. only recent events) or compact/summarize older context.
opciones.D: Enable context caching for the large static prefix (instructions, tool definitions).

preguntas.explicacion: Menos historial por turno (eventos recientes / compactación) y cachear el prefijo estático reducen tokens de entrada y latencia.

preguntas.pregunta: An Agent Runtime deployment has acceptable latency at steady state but p95 spikes during morning bursts because new instances are starting. What should you tune first?

opciones.C: Set min_instances above zero to keep warm capacity (and tune per-instance concurrency for async agents).

preguntas.explicacion: Picos con cold starts → instancias mínimas calientes; para agentes async, ajustar la concurrencia por instancia mejora el aprovechamiento.

preguntas.pregunta: An agent on Agent Runtime must call an internal API reachable only inside the company's VPC (connected to on-prem). How do you provide connectivity?

opciones.A: Make the API public with an API key.
opciones.C: Private Service Connect interface (network attachment) for the agent, with DNS peering for private hostnames.

preguntas.explicacion: Agent Runtime usa PSC interface + network attachment (y DNS peering) para llegar a redes privadas; no conectores de Serverless VPC Access. Exponer la API públicamente degrada la seguridad.
